# Slop Omarchy

First let's see what this slop is made of ... 

DHH's (the Rails guy) "Arch + Hyprland" ... and with the rest of all slops, why did it get hiped because devs thought it was easy to install and for it's AI slop. Omarchy is actually marketed to are the people who *can't* do those things. That's the whole pitch: "Arch for people who don't want to learn Arch." Which means the exact group that should never be running an opinionated bash pile with insecure defaults is the group being handed one, with a sticker on it that says secure, by a guy who tells them reading code is optional now. It's a shit box with RGB. It's "I use Arch btw" for people who have never typed `pacman`. Arch is a lightweight distro were basically empty so people install waht they only want with out needing to bloat it. 

And yes I use Arch btw, and yes have deleted my kernel a few times and broke a couple of stuff here and there but atleast I knew what and fixed it, now to the main point, why slop omarchy is like a garbage can with car modifications.

## The security of this "secure" distro

Okay so the marketing says "secure". Let's see what secure means in slop land.

### August 2026, the month it all leaked

Omarchy 4.0:

- **Shell command injection through video titles.** You play a video, the title has a payload, bash runs it. Through a *title*. This is a bug class from the 90s and the "secure developer distro" shipped it in 2026. Nice joke.
- **Arbitrary code execution through notifications.** A crafted notification pops on your screen and your machine runs whatever the attacker put in it. The notification script was one unquoted variable away from being an RCE daemon. 

Both of these exist for one reason, the whole thing is bash glued together by slop. When your "OS" is a pile of shell scripts that take untrusted strings and pass them straight into `eval` land, this is what you get, every time.

![slop](https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id917932200?pt=39040802&ct=Media1GIFV2&mt=8)

---

### The docker one, bruh

This is the one that hit top of Hacker News, 500+ points, 500+ comments. **Omarchy's default setup adds your user to the `docker` group.**

If you don't know why that's a problem, docker group IS root. Not "kind of root", not "root-ish". Root.

```bash
docker run -it -v /:/host alpine chroot /host
```

Done. You own the machine. So on every Omarchy box before 4.0.1, any process running as you could go to root without a password prompt. Your browser. A random npm `postinstall`. A VS Code extension. The AI agent you let loose in your terminal because DHH said reading code is optional now (Specially fo you cuck coders). Any of them root.

## "But they patched it fast" 


Patching fast is what you do *after* you fail. The question is how a thing called secure shipped root-by-default in the first place, and the answer is nobody in that project sat down and thought about a threat model for even five minutes, they thought about the wallpaper.


### The firewall that wasn't there

Up to 3.1.0 the firewall was configured but **never actually enabled**. The release notes told you there was a firewall. There wasn't. For multiple versions. Nobody noticed because nobody checked, because why would you check, after all you are a cuck coder.

When it finally got turned on, it **allows SSH by default** with stock `sshd_config`, this ... well piece of crap.

![firewall](https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id917932200?pt=39040802&ct=Media1GIFV2&mt=8)

---

### The defaults that make it worse on purpose

- **Password retries got raised, faillock timeouts got shortened.** They made brute forcing a user *easier* for "user experience".
- **Installer takes weak passwords for both your user and your LUKS disk encryption.** Congrats, your full disk encryption is protecting a shit box with the password `omarchy123`.
- **No linux-hardened, no LSM, no hardened_malloc, nothing.** "Security" in Omarchy was never a thing.
- **Install is `curl | bash`.** Pipe a URL into your shell, answer two questions, and a few thousand lines of someone else's bash just ran with sudo on your machine, Tailscale gets piped in the same way.
- **The installer asks for your email** to set `git config`, and then sets up zero GPG or SSH signing. So it wanted your email but not your security.

![ragebait](https://media.tenor.com/FL05Izj3DSkAAAAi/caught-emote-caught-emoji.gif)

## Why this actually matters if you're a dev

"I don't have that much important stuff I am not a hacker" (real respose I got) You dumb fuck, unless you are okay with people seeing what every thing you do on your pc and steal all your account, then yeah go for it.

![dumb](https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id917932200?pt=39040802&ct=Media1GIFV2&mt=8)

**Your machine is the supply chain** Think about what's on a dev laptop, SSH keys to prod. AWS/GCP creds in `~/.aws`. `.npmrc` and `.pypirc` tokens, GitHub tokens with push access, Kubeconfigs. `.env` files you swore you'd delete. Every one of those is readable by any process running as you. On Omarchy before 4.0.1, any process running as you was also root.

**You run untrusted code all day** you are a cuck coder obviously if you use omarchy. You clone random repos, install deps, run their scripts, open their workspace configs.

**AI agents** The whole Omarchy crowd is the "let the agent run commands" crowd. Fine. An agent that gets prompt injected from a README on a normal box can mess up your home directory. An agent that gets prompt injected on an Omarchy box is root. Your agent is one poisoned PR away from being the attacker's agent, with root, on the machine with your prod keys.

**SSH open by default on a laptop** You take that thing to a conference, a coworking space, a cafe. Have fun on that public WiFi.

**You will not notice** That's the part that should scare you. Nothing in this setup logs, alerts, or blocks. No LSM, no hardened kernel, no real firewall rules, nothing. If someone got in through the notification RCE in August you'd have zero idea. Your first sign would be your company's security team asking why prod got accessed from your laptop at 3am.

**Your company's compliance team will hate you** Try explaining in an incident report that your dev machine was a `curl | bash` distro where the user was in the docker group and the firewall was off. Try explaining that to a SOC 2 auditor, He will most likely want you dead.

# Spyware Windows

## Windows was great back on windows XP and 7. But now yeah it's just spyware.

Now it's just a spyware, well most windows users now are office workers and gamers because the triple A companies cheats I mean if you care more about that game than your privacy as you want and just dual boot for the games only.

## Windows 11 isn't an operating system. It's a predatory storefront taped to a kernel.

So let's see what they did to your pc.

### You don't own the pc, you log into it

Remember when you installed windows and it just asked for a username? Yeah that's gone. Home needs a microsoft account since 2021 and everyone was doing the `OOBE\BYPASSNRO` trick to get a local account anyway. Then october 2025 they just killed it, their own words "removing known mechanisms for creating a local account". So the laptop you paid for now needs a cloud account to log in, and that account is what every bit of telemetry gets tied to. Your pc is an account now, bruh.

![nuh_uh](https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id917932200?pt=39040802&ct=Media1GIFV2&mt=8)

### The telemetry you literally can't turn off

Go to the registry, set `AllowTelemetry` to 0. Windows flips it back to 1. On Home and Pro the "off" doesn't exist, you get "Required" and "Optional" and Required is the floor. Only Enterprise and Education get the real off switch, so unless your company is paying for licenses your machine phones home and there is nothing you can do about it on the OS you bought.

### Recall, your whole life in a sqlite file

Okay so people keep saying "windows screenshots your screen and sends it to microsoft". (Well I said this too, yeah big mistake it was loaccly not on their server)

Recall takes a snapshot of your screen every few seconds, OCRs it, and puts it in a database **on your disk**. It doesn't upload it, it's local. That's microsoft's story and nothing shows otherwise.

Here's why it's still insane. The first version, may 2024, stored all of it as a **plain unencrypted sqlite db plus pngs in your user folder**. Readable by any process running as you. Every bank page, every password a field showed, every private chat, every doc, searchable, plain text, for any infostealer to just copy. Malware didn't need to keylog you anymore, microsoft did it for them and left the file open. It took the UK ICO asking questions for them to pull it, make it opt-in, encrypt it and lock it behind windows hello.

![spy](https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id917932200?pt=39040802&ct=Media1GIFV2&mt=8)

### Copilot in literally everything

September 2023, copilot icon you can't remove, Win+C hijacked. Then it spread like mold Notepad, Paint, Photos, Snipping tool, File explorer, Settings, Start search. Why would I need copilot on notepad. Why?

### Ads In the OS

KB5036980, april 2024, "promoted" apps in your start menu. Then ads on the lock screen, ads in settings, ads in file explorer, "tips" that are ads...

### OneDrive took your files hostage

During setup onedrive backup gets turned on quietly, desktop, documents, pictures get moved to the cloud. You hit the 5GB free cap, sync stops, and your files start vanishing locally.

### Windows 10 is dead and your pc is "trash"

October 14 2025, windows 10 EOL. Windows 11 wants TPM 2.0, a specific cpu list and secure boot which cuts off like a fifth of working pcs. So your 2017 i7 that runs everything fine is "unsupported" and if you want security updates for the thing you own that's $30 a year for you, $61 then $122 then $244 per device per year for a business. E-waste as a service.

### And the rest because it doesn't end

Bloatware since 2015, edge shoved in your face hard enough that mozilla wrote a whole report on it, forced restarts since 2021 that took them till march 2026 to fix, a taskbar you couldn't move for 4 years, the august 2025 update (KB5063878) that had people's SSDs just disappearing mid write and corrupting data until microsoft said "can't reproduce" and moved on, updates that randomly kill your audio and bluetooth and you find out when your headset goes silent in a meeting, the bluescreen of death so iconic that one bad crowdstrike driver in july 2024 took 8.5 million windows machines down at once and grounded airlines, which microsoft "fixed" by making the screen black instead of blue, and the ancestor of all of it, 2016, when clicking the red X on the windows 10 upgrade popup *scheduled the upgrade*, they've been like this for a decade you just got used to it.

# Okay so what do I use then smart ass

Depends who you are, find yourself below, and remember the "wah wah commands" thing from the top, most of these you will never open a terminal, I promise.

### Devs

Arch, actual Arch, install it once and you'll understand your machine more than 5 years of windows did. Want hyprland? install hyprland yourself with a config you read. If you want Arch without the install, CachyOS, it's properly packaged and secure boot just works, this is what omarchy pretends to be. EndeavourOS if you want Arch and nothing else. If you have a job and just want it to work, Fedora, SELinux on by default and it doesn't break. Debian for servers. NixOS if you like pain.

And whatever you pick, rootless docker or at least know what docker group means, turn on the firewall, close ssh if you don't need it.

### Normal people, browse, youtube, documents

Linux Mint. That's it that's the answer. Looks like windows, works like windows minus the spyware, driver manager, update manager, app store, you will never see a terminal. Give it to your parents. Zorin if you want it to look even more like windows. Ubuntu is fine too just more canonical flavoured.

LibreOffice opens your docx, firefox is firefox, your printer will probably work better than on windows not even joking.

![it_just_works](https://media.tenor.com/_6N6J2xPY_wAAAAi/tux-linux.gif)

If one anticheat game is your whole life, dual boot like I said, windows stays offline-ish for just that game and your actual life goes on linux.
